subject: cuckoo bumblebee
title: This Bumblebee Has No Workers. It Takes Over Another Queen's Nest

scenes.text: This bumblebee can't carry pollen and has no workers. It still raises a big family.
The vestal cuckoo bumblebee waits until a buff-tailed queen has built her nest and raised workers.
Then it moves in, armored with a harder shell, stronger jaws and a powerful sting.
Some cuckoo bees copy the nest's scent. Others carry a smell that pushes the workers away.
Then it kills or subdues the queen and lays its own eggs.
The workers raise the invader's babies as their own. Britain has six bumblebees that live like this.

description:
Cuckoo bumblebees have no pollen baskets and no worker caste. A female such as the vestal cuckoo bumblebee (Bombus vestalis) invades the nest of its host, the buff-tailed bumblebee, kills or subdues the queen and has the host workers raise its young.
They have a harder exoskeleton, stronger mandibles and a longer sting; some mimic the host's scent, while others produce a repellent chemical. The UK has six cuckoo bumblebee species.
Which insect trick surprises you the most?
first_comment: Each of Britain's six cuckoo bumblebees targets its own host species. Have you ever spotted a bee that looked a bit too armored?
